witness.statement:
∀ (a u k m : Nat),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    instLENat.le 1 a →
      instLENat.le a k →
        instLENat.le 1 u →
          instLENat.le u k →
            instLENat.le 1 m →
              instLENat.le m (instHSub.hSub k 2) →
                ∀ (side : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side) (word : List ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter),
                  (∀ (x : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter),
                      List.instMembership.mem word x →
                        Or (Eq x ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child)
                          (Eq x (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.ext 1 side))) →
                    have σ :=
                      { a := a, u := u, k := k, word := word, maxima := List.cons m List.nil };
                    have opposite := fun s =>
                      ErdosSzekeres.ctx_one_level_root_bound_attained_by_extreme_run_end_singleton_cut.match_1
                        (fun s => ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side) s (fun _ => ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper)
                        fun _ => ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower;
                    have ps := σ.childPositions;
                    have starts :=
                      List.filter
                        (fun p =>
                          Decidable.decide
                            (Or (Eq p 0)
                              (Ne (σ.letterAt (instHSub.hSub p 1)) ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child)))
                        ps;
                    have ends :=
                      List.filter
                        (fun p =>
                          Decidable.decide
                            (Or (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd p 1) word.length)
                              (Ne (σ.letterAt (instHAdd.hAdd p 1)) ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child)))
                        ps;
                    instLENat.le 2 σ.numRuns →
                      Exists fun p =>
                        And (List.instMembership.mem ps p)
                          (And
                            (List.instMembership.mem
                              (List.cons (ps.head?.getD 0)
                                (List.cons (ends.head?.getD 0)
                                  (List.cons (starts.getLast?.getD 0)
                                    (List.cons (ps.getLast?.getD 0) List.nil))))
                              p)
                            (Exists fun s =>
                              Exists fun c =>
                                And (instLENat.le 1 c)
                                  (And (instLENat.le c (instHSub.hSub k 2))
                                    (instLENat.le σ.bound
                                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                                        (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold
                                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                                            ((σ.part (List.cons p List.nil) s c).capLimit p p) 1)
                                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                                            ((σ.part (List.cons p List.nil) s c).cupLimit p p) 1)
                                          k)
                                        (σ.part
                                            (List.filter (fun r => Decidable.decide (Ne r p)) ps)
                                            (opposite s)
                                            (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub k 1) c)).bound)))))
